cp1RuleChoiceHeld.decision: gate the companion stamp on the PRIMARY's own join-miss badge (isCadJoinMissBasis), not on the record's join-miss state
cp1RuleChoiceHeld.why: applyCadJoinMiss runs for every record whose propId missed, but each cell is written only while it is `unaccounted`. A cell may already be absent-verified from an earlier matched-row pass, with a taxYear-bearing basis; stamping a join-miss provenance beside it would write an internally inconsistent pair and diverge from the factory predicate, which also keys on the primary's badge. Gating on the badge makes the pair self-consistent, makes the pass idempotent, and is exactly what lets the parity test be an exact cell-for-cell equality rather than an approximation.
cp1RuleChoiceHeld.adversarialRecheck: the one way this choice could be wrong is a record whose primary is absent-verified with a join-miss-SHAPED basis that did NOT come from a join miss (e.g. a matched row that somehow lost its taxYear). No such producer exists in this repo at 7b3dda0b: cadNullVerified (ingest-existing.ts:126-140) REFUSES to emit without a taxYear, so a taxYear-less cad_property basis can only come from cadJoinMissVerified. Recorded as the residual assumption behind the rule.

hazardDirectionsStated.ops24Law7: OPS-24 law 7 warns that a write putting an `unaccounted` cell on a slated rail turns that county's ledger values back to the bake until P-297. This lane's writer moves cells unaccounted -> absent-verified on two provenance rails beside primaries that are already absent-verified with a declared basis, i.e. it REMOVES unaccounted cells and never adds one, and this lane writes no store at all (no read, no lease). Stated at CP1 and repeated here on the record.
hazardDirectionsStated.enforcementNeverRelabel: ENFORCEMENT forbids converting `unaccounted` to `absent-verified` to clear a gate. Not gate-driven here: no gate is consulted or cleared, something DID look (the CAD ingest query ran for the county and observed no row for this propId in any tax year), the absence is already written on the primary with a declared basis, and the companion is a provenance field whose only honest value is that same absence. Any cell whose primary is not itself verified absent is untouched — which is what falsifier 3b measures.
